The numbers come from a guide for parents. The National PTA and the National Education Association (NEA) wrote it in 2000. Harris Cooper, a homework researcher, quoted it in 2001.

Here is what the guide says: "Most educators agree that for children in grades K–2, homework is most effective when it does not exceed 10–20 minutes each day; older children, in grades 3–6, can handle 30–60 minutes a day."
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend 10 minutes of homework for kindergarten students.
